description.value: This Starbucks location sits along Ladner Trunk Road in Tsawwassen, positioning it as a convenient stop for cyclists traveling through the Delta region or connecting to the BC Ferries terminal. As a full-service Starbucks café, it offers a broad menu of hot and cold beverages alongside grab-and-go food items. The corporate brand's consistent service model makes it a reliable refuelling point on longer coastal rides.
